Task: OCR and Layout Extraction

Write code that extracts blocks, lines, tables, or layout elements from a document using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Google Document AI:
  Service: Google Document AI
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/overview

Option 2 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Document OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, enqueue_and_parse
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 3 — Azure Document Intelligence:
  Service: Azure AI Document Intelligence
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/overview

Option 4 — Amazon Textract:
  Service: Amazon Textract
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_document_text, analyze_document
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 5 — Alibaba Cloud OCR:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeGeneral, RecognizeAdvanced
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


def _bbox_from_geometry(geometry: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, float]]:
    polygon = geometry.get("Polygon") or geometry.get("polygon") or []
    if not polygon:
        return None

    xs = []
    ys = []
    for p in polygon:
        if "X" in p and "Y" in p:
            xs.append(float(p["X"]))
            ys.append(float(p["Y"]))
        elif "x" in p and "y" in p:
            xs.append(float(p["x"]))
            ys.append(float(p["y"]))
    if not xs or not ys:
        return None
    return {
        "left": min(xs),
        "top": min(ys),
        "right": max(xs),
        "bottom": max(ys),
    }


def _normalize_block(block: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    block_type = block.get("BlockType")
    item: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "id": block.get("Id"),
        "type": block_type,
        "text": None,
        "confidence": block.get("Confidence"),
        "bbox": _bbox_from_geometry(block.get("Geometry", {})) if block.get("Geometry") else None,
        "relationships": block.get("Relationships", []),
    }

    if block_type in {"LINE", "WORD", "TABLE", "CELL", "KEY_VALUE_SET"}:
        if "Text" in block:
            item["text"] = block.get("Text")
        elif block_type == "CELL":
            item["text"] = ""
        elif block_type == "TABLE":
            item["text"] = None
        elif block_type == "KEY_VALUE_SET":
            item["text"] = None

    if block_type == "CELL":
        item["row_index"] = block.get("RowIndex")
        item["column_index"] = block.get("ColumnIndex")
        item["row_span"] = block.get("RowSpan")
        item["column_span"] = block.get("ColumnSpan")

    if block_type == "KEY_VALUE_SET":
        item["entity_types"] = block.get("EntityTypes", [])

    return item


def extract_layout_elements(
    document_bytes: bytes,
    *,
    feature_types: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    aws_region: Optional[str] = None,
    mime_type: str = "application/pdf",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Extract OCR and layout elements from a document using Amazon Textract.

    Returns a dictionary with normalized blocks, lines, tables, and cells.
    """
    if feature_types is None:
        feature_types = ["TABLES", "FORMS"]

    region = aws_region or os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or "us-east-1"
    client = boto3.client("textract", region_name=region)

    try:
        response = client.analyze_document(
            Document={"Bytes": document_bytes},
            FeatureTypes=feature_types,
        )
    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError):
        response = client.detect_document_text(
            Document={"Bytes": document_bytes},
        )

    blocks = response.get("Blocks", [])
    normalized_blocks = [_normalize_block(block) for block in blocks]

    lines = [b for b in normalized_blocks if b["type"] == "LINE"]
    words = [b for b in normalized_blocks if b["type"] == "WORD"]
    tables = [b for b in normalized_blocks if b["type"] == "TABLE"]
    cells = [b for b in normalized_blocks if b["type"] == "CELL"]
    key_values = [b for b in normalized_blocks if b["type"] == "KEY_VALUE_SET"]

    return {
        "provider": "amazon-textract",
        "mime_type": mime_type,
        "blocks": normalized_blocks,
        "lines": lines,
        "words": words,
        "tables": tables,
        "cells": cells,
        "key_value_sets": key_values,
        "raw_response": response,
    }
